$description: Every text and focus-ring colour, each surface or fill the demo puts it on, and the contrast ratio it must reach there: 4.5 for text, 3 for the focus ring. npm run check measures each pair for every brand and for no brand, in light and in dark. Card borders, dividers and the edges of status notices are decorative and left out. The button is listed by its own tokens, the ones the demo reads, which also covers color.text.on-fill. Disabled text, color.text.disabled, is left out: WCAG sets no contrast minimum for a control that cannot be used, its text and edges included.

color.text.default.$description: Page and panel text on the page; titles, the price and the feature list on a card.

color.text.subtle.$description: Panel labels on the page; the lede and the price line on a card.

color.text.brand.$description: The tag's text and the feature list's ticks.

color.text.link.$description: A link beside a card on the page, and the link inside a card.

button.label.$description: The button's text, at rest, under the pointer and pressed.

color.border.focus.$description: The ring sits focus.offset outside the link or button it marks, so it is drawn on what is around it, never on the button's fill. That is the page for the comparison link beside a card, and the card for the card's button and link and for every button in the states row, the focused one included. Nothing else in the demo takes focus: the status card has no link or button.

color.text.success.$description: The words of a success notice, on its soft fill.

color.text.on-success.$description: The words of a success badge, such as Paid, on its solid fill.

color.text.warning.$description: The words of a warning notice, on its soft fill.

color.text.on-warning.$description: The words of a warning badge, such as Due soon, on its solid fill.

color.text.critical.$description: The words of a critical notice, on its soft fill.

color.text.on-critical.$description: The words of a critical badge, such as Failed, on its solid fill.

color.text.info.$description: The words of an info notice, on its soft fill.

color.text.on-info.$description: The words of an info badge, such as New, on its solid fill.
